critical_code_review_comments: Buy Plan Readiness Dashboard implementation is complete and working correctly
Readiness API returns 8 checks covering: store_wedge, style_mix, daily_sales, sku_master, sell_through, inventory, display_minimums, promotions

ai_insights module controls /ai-demand visibility, space_planning controls /planogram visibility
Module toggle changes take effect after page reload (sidebar fetches tenantModules on mount)
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
